chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):

The saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious, 'Remember Allah with much remembrance.' What is the much remembrance? He said, 'That he glorifies (says SubhanAllah) thirty times after the obligatory prayer.'

key_terms.ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا: Much remembrance (a Quranic term for frequent dhikr)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific method of dhikr kathir after obligatory prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Sahih al-Tusi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the Quranic command to 'remember Allah with much remembrance' by specifying the recitation of Subhanallah thirty times after each obligatory prayer. This establishes a foundational Sunnah for post-prayer dhikr, linking the general Quranic injunction to a specific, quantifiable act of worship that reinforces spiritual mindfulness immediately following the ritual prayer.
